holdings.name: Nvidia
holdings.thesis: We own NVDA because the global data-center buildout drives sustained demand for its AI chips, and its software ecosystem keeps customers locked in.
holdings.chain: Upstream: TSM (manufacturing), memory suppliers. Downstream: cloud providers (GOOG etc.); their AI capex is NVDA demand. Deployment depends on data-center construction, power, cooling.
guide: A cloud provider changes its AI capex plans; data-center power/construction bottleneck

holdings.name: TSMC (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing)
holdings.thesis: We own TSM because it manufactures most leading-edge chips for every major AI chip designer, so it benefits from AI demand regardless of which designer wins.
holdings.chain: Downstream: NVDA, Apple, AMD and cloud providers' custom chips (incl. Google TPUs). Upstream: equipment and materials suppliers.
guide: Leading-edge capacity or pricing news; Taiwan tension

holdings.name: Alphabet (Google)
holdings.thesis: We own GOOG because search and YouTube generate strong cash flow that funds AI and a fast-growing cloud business, making it both a seller and a buyer in the AI buildout.
holdings.chain: Downstream: ads and cloud services. Upstream: buyer of NVDA GPUs and TSM-made TPUs (its capex = their revenue).
guide: Search share data; antitrust remedy ruling; AI capex change

holdings.name: JPMorgan Chase
holdings.thesis: We own JPM because higher-for-longer rates support its net interest income, and the AI and energy investment cycle drives lending and investment-banking fees.
holdings.chain: Finances the buildout: data-center construction, energy projects, cloud providers' bond issuance. Oil → inflation → Fed path drives rates.
guide: Fed rate decision; credit loss trends
Investment-banking fee outlook; large buildout financing deal

holdings.name: Exxon Mobil
holdings.thesis: We own XOM because the Middle East conflict keeps oil prices elevated while low-cost production growth funds dividends and buybacks, with added upside from rising power demand for data centers.
holdings.chain: Upstream: Permian, Guyana production. Downstream: refining and chemicals. Data-center power demand supports natural gas. Iran conflict / Middle East supply risk keeps an oil premium.
guide: Oil price shock; Middle East supply news; Guyana production update
